scenes.title: Trying to Lose the Election
scenes.summary: A reluctant candidate wants to quit her city council race, but her campaign advisors warn her about a party fine and suggest saying something outrageous on a podcast so no one votes for her.

scenes.title: The Most-Voted City Councilor
scenes.summary: The podcast stunt backfires when she wins by a landslide, and her advisors convince her to try getting stripped of office by saying something even worse.

scenes.title: From Congresswoman to President
scenes.summary: Each scandal only propels her higher, taking her from most-voted congresswoman all the way to the presidency while her team brainstorms new taboos.

scenes.title: The Message from the Ballot Boxes
scenes.summary: After voters reward every provocation, her secret wish to pass a public university exam finally comes true and she learns she actually has to study.
